newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat says 80,000 Brava/Bravo cars in recall.
newsitem.headline: Fiat says 80,000 Brava/Bravo cars in recall.

text.p: Italian car maker Fiat said 80,000 Brava/Bravo models were affected by a recall it announced earlier on Thursday to replace a brake component.
A spokesman for Fiat said this was "probably the biggest recall" the group had ever made.

Others included a recall of a small number of Punto models in July 1995 to check the anti-lock braking system (ABS) and of Alfa Romeo convertible and GTV models in January of the same year to check seatbelt fittings, the spokesman said.
